subject: english
stem: Which sentence has correct subject-be agreement?
options: I is looking at the color.
The color of the doors is bright.
The color of the doors are bright.

optionRationales.reason: The doors is bright.：複數 doors 不搭 is。
I is looking at the color.：I 不搭 is。
The color of the doors is bright.：核心主詞 color 單數，因此用 is。
The color of the doors are bright.：誤由 doors 控制謂語。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「以主詞的人稱與數決定 be 形式，再以明確時間線索區分現在 am/is/are 與過去 was/were。」可推出 The color of the doors is bright.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The color of the doors is bright. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
